_README: SAMPLE CATALOG built from the shop's own photos (TikTok, Yelp). Prices are placeholders. Edit freely: add a product by copying an entry, putting its photo in assets-src/ as p-<image>.jpg, and running `node scripts/build-images.mjs`. Or use the Owner catalog page (/owner).

products.name: Amethyst Druzy Heart
